headline: Low outlook for long outages in Tom Green County
summary: Homes in Tom Green County lose power for 12 hours or more about once every 9 years. That comes from 8 years of records since 2018. The largest outage here began on February 14, 2021. At its peak, 49% of homes in the county were dark. For a home with gas heat and a larger footprint, one Core lasts about 15 hours in August and about 38 hours in November. We suggest two Cores. That would have covered 96% of past long outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
